Nor yet was it in the flowing trains, the graceful ruffs, the pearls wreathed in the pleached and plaited hair, the diamond stomachers, and chains of goldsmiths' work — it was not in these, that centred the attraction of the glorious concourse — though with these, not the costliest pageantry of modern times, could for a moment's space compare.
Many an ancient brocade had been awakened for the nonce from its lavender bed, and ruffs and gold braid were at no premium.
